issuers.name: xStocks
issuers.summary: Each token tracks one share and is backed by shares held in custody. You own a certificate issued by Backed, not the share.
issuers.holderRights: No voting rights. Dividends are reinvested by adjusting your token amount. Redeeming directly needs identity checks and at least 5,000 US dollars.
issuers.warning: These products suit only people who can afford to lose the money they put in and who understand the risks. Their issue is not covered by all of Jersey's financial services law.

attestation.text: I am not a US person and I do not live in the United Kingdom, Canada or Australia. I have read the xStocks warning and accept the xStocks terms.

issuers.name: Backpack
issuers.summary: Each token is a receipt for a share held in trust by Backpack's issuer. You do not own the share.
issuers.holderRights: No voting rights. Dividends are reinvested by adjusting your token amount.
issuers.warning: The issuer does not recognise wallet holders. To redeem, you must move the tokens into a verified Backpack account. Otherwise you can only sell them, and Backpack says they may be worthless to you.

attestation.text: I am not a US person and I do not live in a country Backpack Securities excludes. I understand the issuer does not recognise wallet holders, and I accept the Backpack Securities terms.

issuers.name: Ondo
issuers.summary: Each token is a note that tracks one share, backed by shares held through a US broker. You do not own the share.
issuers.holderRights: No voting or shareholder rights. Dividends are reinvested after tax by adjusting your token amount. Prices come from market makers, and trading can pause outside US market hours or around company events.
issuers.warning: Only professional investors may buy in the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area, Switzerland, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia and Brazil.

attestation.text: I am not a US person and I do not live in a country Ondo prohibits. If I live where only professional investors may buy, I am one. I accept the Ondo Global Markets terms.

issuers.name: PreStocks
issuers.summary: Each token claims economic exposure to a private company through arrangements PreStocks does not disclose. You own no shares.
issuers.holderRights: No ownership, voting, dividend or information rights. A token can expire worthless if it is not converted after the company lists.
issuers.warning: Anthropic and OpenAI have said transfers of their shares through such vehicles are void. Each transfer costs a fee the issuer can change.
excludedRegions: Other countries listed in the PreStocks terms

attestation.text: I am not a US person and I do not live in a country PreStocks prohibits, and I accept the PreStocks terms.

issuers.name: Tessera
issuers.summary: Each token is a share in a small loan to a Panama company that holds private company exposure. It is not a share.
issuers.holderRights: No ownership, voting or dividend rights. You are repaid only after the position is sold, inside a 90 day window.
issuers.warning: If you miss the 90 day redemption window, your claim is lost.
excludedRegions: Countries on the FATF grey or black list

attestation.text: I am not a US person and I do not live in a country Tessera excludes, and I accept the Tessera terms.
